services.desc: Cruise the most visited area in all of Tahoe and one of the most photographed areas in the world!!! Duration 2 Hours About This popular afternoon cruise takes a tour across 6 miles of crystal clear water from South Lake Tahoe into Emerald Bay. You will be surrounded by the majestic mountains of Lake Tahoe. services.name: Emerald Bay Happy Hour Cruise
services.desc: This cruise has Bar Tenders Choice drink specials! Duration 2 Hours About This popular afternoon cruise takes a tour across 6 miles of crystal clear water from South Lake Tahoe into Emerald Bay, the most visited area in all of Tahoe and one of the most photographed areas in the world!!! We will enter through the mouth of the bay where you most likely will see bald eagles nesting high above in the trees. Once in the bay, we will stop in front of the popular Vikingsholm Castle to take breathtaking pictures. In the middle of the bay we will stop at Fannette Island where the historical "Tea Hut" is located. After our tour of Emerald Bay, we head back across Tahoe Keys! About the Tahoe Bleu Wave

blurb: Guests can enjoy various cruises aboard a classic 1966 Million Dollar Yacht, including sunset cruises, sightseeing tours to Emerald Bay, and special event cruises like the 4th of July Fireworks Cruise. The yacht offers indoor and outdoor seating with panoramic views of Lake Tahoe and surrounding landmarks. The company also hosts wedding ceremonies and receptions on the yacht at multiple scenic locations on Lake Tahoe.
